record={'schemaVersion':'cvf.localDockerQueryOuterSpend@1','state':'SPENT_BEFORE_TARGET_INTERPRETER','programOrdinal':1,'programCap':1,'utilityCap':4,'outerSeconds':60,'chargedUtc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'baseline':{'path':baseline.as_posix(),'sha256':sha(raw_baseline)},'driver':{'path':driver.as_posix(),'sha256':sha(raw_driver)},'argv':[sys.executable,'-B',str(driver)]}

with (p/'docker-program-launch.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:f.write(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');f.flush()
